# S08 — Architect role in the engine

**Findings:**  · **Size:** L · **Tree:**

**2026-10-19** — From S10: split-part and sliver prompts need the same "no handoff before review" wording as the implementer prompt.

**Not in this slice:**

## Why

The architect role is named and prompted, but the engine never runs it. The role is in internal/roles/roles.go:37, its prompt is internal/roles/prompts/architect.md, and it is read-only (internal/engine/perm.go:39). The engine's role loops cover only implementer, reviewer and gate (internal/engine/engine.go:160-166; internal/daemon/runs.go:210). rg finds no architect round in internal/engine. A size L slice therefore gets no architect review today.
Decided 2026-10-20 (record 123, slice.architect-order): the architect follows the slicer contract. docs/design.md:191-193 says the architect runs alongside the reviewer. The slicer contract (`slicer ai relay`, the orchestrator steps) says it runs after accepted findings and before the gate. The contract also says the architect is optional and the owner decides.
docs/design.md:191-193 is to be corrected in this slice.
